budgets.label: critical path (package code in the entry chunk)
budgets.why: User-facing promise of the package, accepted by the owner on 2026-10-23 when the demo budget moved to 101.5 KB: the default configuration adds at most 1 KB to the critical path and the first MP4 loads at most 24 KB lazily. This row is the first half: the package code in the host entry chunk (the lazyProbe stub, ProbeError and the engine list), cut out of the entry chunk by its sourcemap. Vite's preload helper is not counted here, because every Vite app with a dynamic import already has it; the entry chunk row counts it. Design estimate 1.0 KB; measured 0.67 KB, and measured plus 10 percent rounded up to 0.5 KB is also 1.0 KB.

budgets.label: entry chunk with the preload helper
budgets.why: The whole host entry chunk: the package code of the critical path row, Vite's preload helper, which Vite adds to the entry chunk of any app with a dynamic import, and the one line of host code. The critical path row stays the package promise; this row also catches what the package makes Vite add next to its code, such as a longer preload dependency list per dynamic import. Measured 1.40 KB. The limit is the first measurement from the packed tarball plus 10 percent, rounded up to 0.5 KB.
